source_snapshot.items: Firmware upgrade power-loss failure for ERoT/Aps; prior version intact.
source_snapshot.procedure: Unplug power during update, restore power and check version.

old_problem: ERoT/Aps target/banks and a vendor-safe observable interruption phase, dwell and recovery state are undefined.
disposition_reason: Mid-update power removal is destructive physical fault injection. ED-16/18 require exact vendor-approved stage, isolation and recovery; these cannot be parameterized without core firmware atomicity semantics.
decision_basis: Kept power-loss distinct from invalid-image rejection.
No flash, cord removal or power cycle occurred.

test_case.purpose: Interrupt an approved ERoT/Aps update at the vendor-defined commit phase and prove rollback to intact prior firmware and normal boot.
required_package: Dedicated fixture and independent power control
test_case.test_command: Do not execute until vendor authority identifies the interruption boundary. A qualified operator starts the scoped update, removes power only at that boundary, observes OFF dwell, restores power and performs full inventory/boot/health recovery checks.
test_case.expected_result: Update fails safely, prior active firmware remains intact, and OFF-ON-OS-ready plus component health complete normally.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Arbitrary unplug timing or boot alone cannot validate atomic rollback.
test_case.recovery: Use vendor unbrick/OOB procedure if rollback or boot fails; do not repeat interruption.

source_conflict.reason: Named components and update-time phase have no authoritative mapping.

blocked.reason: Execution has an irreducible destructive timing/recovery blocker.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Provide target/bank, vendor-safe interruption stage/dwell, rollback state and unbrick path.
pending.owner: ERoT/Aps firmware and platform power owners.

project_authority: Firmware atomicity and safe interruption stage are vendor-specific.
